chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from al-Hakam ibn 'Ilba' al-Asadi, who said:

I was appointed over al-Bahrayn and acquired abundant wealth there. I spent from it, purchased many landed properties, bought slaves and slave-mothers who bore children for me. Then I set out for Makkah, carrying my dependents, the mothers of my children, and my wives, and I carried the khums of that wealth. I entered upon Abu Ja'far عليه السلام and said to him: “I was appointed over al-Bahrayn and acquired abundant wealth there, and I purchased properties, bought slaves, bought slave-mothers who bore children for me, and I spent from it. This is the khums of that wealth, and these are the mothers of my children and my wives, and I have brought it to you.” So he said to him: “Indeed, all of it belongs to us, and I have accepted what you have brought. I have made lawful for you the mothers of your children, your wives, and what you spent, and I guarantee for you, upon myself and upon my father, Paradise.”

key_terms.أُمَّهَاتِ أَوْلَادٍ: slave-mothers who bore children to their master
key_terms.الْبَحْرَيْنَ: al-Bahrayn, the region over which the narrator says he was appointed
key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, which the Imam عليه السلام guarantees for him
key_terms.حَلَّلْتُكَ: I made it lawful for you
key_terms.خُمُسَ: the one-fifth due from the wealth
key_terms.ضِيَاعًا: landed properties or estates that were purchased
key_terms.مَالًا: wealth or property acquired in large quantity

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith from al-Istibsar say about khums, acquired wealth, and the Imam’s granting of permissibility?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a man informing Abu Ja'far عليه السلام about wealth he acquired while governing al-Bahrayn, including property, slaves, and slave-mothers, and bringing the khums of that wealth to him. Abu Ja'far عليه السلام states that it all belongs to them, accepts what was brought, declares lawful for him what had been involved of his women and expenditures, and guarantees him Paradise.
